item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 22/Oct/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The northeast monsoon will continue to affect the coast of Guangdong today, it will be slightly cooler and windier over the region. With the strengthening of the anticyclone aloft, the weather over the coast of southern China will be mainly fine and dry with temperatures rising in the next few days. Another surge of the northeast monsoon is expected to reach southern China in the latter part of this week, it will become cloudier gradually with rain over the region.

Date/Month: 22/10 (Sunday)
Wind: North to northeast force 4 to 5, occasionally force 6 offshore and on high ground at first.
Weather: Mainly cloudy. Slightly cooler with one or two light rain patches in the morning. Dry with sunny intervals during the day.
Temp range: 20 - 25 C
R.H. range: 65 - 90 per Cent
PSR: Low
